== 说明 ==
要使用此模板，添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom 信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Event
 | title         = 
 | image         = [例如 "Example.jpg"]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | performers  = 
 | date          = 
 | location      = 
}}
</pre>

== 示例输出 ==
{{Event
 | title         = 每日精选花卉
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | performers    = 优秀演出者
 | date          = 永久开放
 | location      = 所有地点
}}
<pre>
{{Event
 | title         = Flower du Jour
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | performers    = Awesome Ones
 | date          = All the time
 | location      = Everywhere
}}
</pre><includeonly>[[Category:Infobox templates]]</includeonly><noinclude>[[Category:Template documentation]]</noinclude>
